name: Another Report from the Grey Road

text.summary: While you work, another frightened report reaches Dunmere: the road is not waiting for anyone to finish thinking.
text.full: A messenger, a traveler, or just a breathless rumor reaches you with the same shape every time: the road has gone wrong again, and delay is starting to become part of the problem.

prompt_text: Another troubling report arrives from the Grey Road. How do you answer the mounting pressure?

options.label: Press on toward the likely source
options.description: Treat the new report as confirmation that delay will only make the road worse.

knowledge_entries.title: Another attack report came in
knowledge_entries.summary: Fresh reports made it clear the Grey Road would keep worsening if no one pushed on.

resolution_payload.source_knowledge_summary: Another report from the road convinced you to move toward the likely source.

options.label: Pause long enough to steady the village
options.description: Accept the pressure, but answer it carefully instead of rushing blind.

knowledge_entries.title: Another attack report came in
knowledge_entries.summary: Fresh reports raised the pressure around Dunmere, even as you chose not to rush blindly.

resolution_payload.source_knowledge_summary: The road worsened, but you chose not to let urgency decide everything for you.
